text: I've got a new client.
Great.
Now I need to find their emails,
create a project, send a proposal,
track feedback and remember when to invoice them.
Where do you manage all of that?
That's the problem.
Five different places.
Why not manage the entire client journey in one place?
Can it handle everything from the first inquiry
to the final payment?
Let's follow one client.
A new inquiry comes in.
Track the lead, book a discovery call,
send your proposal and follow it through.
And when they accept?
Your won lead becomes a project.
No starting over.
Now share the work with your client
through their branded portal.
They can review proofs, leave comments
and approve deliverables.
And what happens to all that feedback?
Turn actionable comments into tasks.
Your team handles the revisions,
and the feedback stays connected to the original proof.
And what if the client wants more work
than we originally agreed?
Handle scope changes with change orders,
so additional work is properly documented.
Projects, tasks, team, calendar, communication,
invoices and payments.
It's all connected.
So I'm not jumping between five different tools anymore?
Exactly.
From the first inquiry to the final payment.
Run your creative studio with Nodstage.
